name: Qal Sisma Mountains
description: The mountains where the Atarka clan dwells, whose glaciers have melted since Atarka's arrival.

timeline.summary: Flashback: sick of endless blood, Sarkhan leaves his clan for the Qal Sisma Mountains, where a figure takes his shape and he joins the whisperers' chant of dragons.
Atarka's arrival and storms melt the Qal Sisma glaciers, and she wipes out the mammoths and most of the former Temur shamans.
timeline.quote: Atarka quickly devoured most of the shamans of the former Temur clan

pages_say.description: The snowy mountains where Sarkhan went and met the whisperers.
The mountains where the Atarka clan dwells, whose glaciers have melted since Atarka's arrival.
